description: The Boden Type Data Centre consortium publishes operational observations from its Swedish demonstration facility. POD 1 measurements cover 5 March 2019 to 2 March 2020, including power, temperature, humidity, fan speeds, server utilisation and weather; POD 3 has a shorter period. The repository describes hourly Excel summaries and test-campaign measurements at 15–30-second intervals. Fordatis identifies CC BY-ND 4.0, whereas DataCite lists version 2.0; this licence-version conflict is retained, with free access under either stated version. The data can calibrate cooling and energy simulations for the facility documented in case_study-boden-type-data-centre-one. That case record does not explicitly link this dataset. Site-specific cooling configurations and incomplete POD coverage limit generalisation; file values were not checked.
